documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Management stated that Baheti Recycling Industries Limited delivered strong financial performance in FY26 with revenue rising to 725 crores and profit reaching 27 crores. The company is expanding its capacity by commencing 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27, taking total installed capacity to 38,000 tons annually. Furthermore, management highlighted an ongoing investment of around 25 crores into an aluminum wire rod project in Dahegam across two phases to capture higher-margin opportunities. The company is heading into FY27 with a minimum order book of 200 crores, excluding the wire rod plant. Baheti Recycling reported a good financial year for FY26, surpassing its stated revenue guidance by 12% and achieving PAT growth of over 15% compared to guidance.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by FY28.
guidance.quote: Our plan is to ramp up utilization, full capacity utilization by FY28.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 of the aluminum wire rod project targets an annual revenue potential of 250 crores.
guidance.quote: We are targeting in Phase 1 around 12,500 metric ton per annum, with an annual revenue potential of 250-odd crores

guidance.claim: Total revenue from both phases of the aluminum wire rod plant will be around 500 crores.
guidance.quote: So, total revenue from this plant will be somewhere around 500 odd crores.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching a 4-digit revenue figure in the financial year.
guidance.quote: I'm more than hopeful that we'll reach somewhere around 4-digit in this financial alone.

guidance.claim: Sustainable EBITDA margins for the industry and the company range between 7% to 10%.
guidance.quote: See, the EBITDA margin in our industry is a sustainable EBITDA margin which we are working on. So anywhere between 7 to 10% is very it's quite sustainable EBITDA margin in our kind of industry

guidance.claim: The company surpassed its stated revenue guidance by 12% for FY26.
guidance.quote: We closed the year having surpassed our stated revenue guidance by 12%, with PAT growth coming in at over 15% against what we had guided for.

guidance.claim: Management stated a target revenue milestone of exceeding ₹1,200 Crores by FY28.
guidance.quote: We are confidently positioned to exceed a Revenue milestone of ₹1,200Cr by FY28

demand_outlook.claim: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted by geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, pushing customers towards secondary sources.
demand_outlook.quote: Global primary aluminum supply has been disrupted, particularly from the geopolitical tension going on in the Middle East, and that is pushing customer everywhere towards reliable secondary sources.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand is strong, government policy tailwinds exist, and global industry dynamics favor secondary recycling aluminum.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand is that the government policy tailwinds are there, the global industry dynamics are in favor of secondary recycling aluminium.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic scrap is currently much more expensive than imported scrap.
demand_outlook.quote: Sir, as on date, domestic scrap is much expensive than imported scrap, number one.

demand_outlook.claim: Confirmed order book stands at over ₹175 Crores as the company steps into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As we step into Q1 FY27, our confirmed order book already stands at over ₹175 Crores, a reflection of the steady demand for secondary aluminium domestically and the trust our clients continue to place in us.

demand_outlook.claim: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and pressure on availability is real.
demand_outlook.quote: Disruptions in the Middle East have tightened primary aluminium supply globally, and the pressure on availability is real.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this, we are now ready to commence 5 new electrical furnaces in FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The solar plant is on track to be commenced by the end of May 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: that will be combined with our solar plant, which is on track, and which will be commenced by the end of May 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing around 25 crores to build out the aluminum wire rod product in two phases on existing freehold land in Dahegam.
capex_expansion.quote: We are investing somewhere around 25-odd crores to build this out in two phases on our existing freehold land in Dahegam

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the wire rod project will increase capacity to 25,000 tons and revenue by another 250 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: In phase 2, it will increase to 25,000 tons. That, that means the revenue will also increase by another 250 odd crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 capex for the furnace will be a maximum of 5 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 would be 5 crores maximum in putting up the furnace and all.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing ₹20–25 Crores in FY27 to build out the Aluminium Wire Rod division on existing freehold land.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we added some clients we are genuinely proud of - TVS Motor Company, Royal Enfield, Bajaj Auto- all of whom are now being supplied directly for their automotive requirements.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Aluminium Wire Rod division targets 12,500 MT capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 targets 12,500 MT, which we expect to generate between ₹200–250 Crores in annual revenue.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 plans to scale the Aluminium Wire Rod division to 25,000 MT in forthcoming years.
capex_expansion.quote: When we scale to 25,000 MT in Phase 2 in forthcoming years, the revenue potential from this division alone reaches ₹500 Crores a year.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, we have been replacing our older pit furnaces with more Electric Furnaces, taking our total smelting capacity to 38,000 MT, and five more furnaces are lined up for FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Five more electric furnaces are lined up for commission in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Our captive solar plant should be running by end of May 2026 and this directly cuts our power costs on the electric furnaces, and the margin benefit will start showing up from Q2 onwards.

margins_costs.quote: Beyond our core alloy and deoxidant line, we are now entering into aluminum wire rod product, which is a higher margin product segment.

margins_costs.claim: The EBITDA margin for the wire rod business will improve by 1% or 2% from the existing business.
